profile.description: Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG develops, owns, and operates an electricity generation and seawater desalination plant in the Salalah region. The company operates Salalah independent water and power plant that comprises 5 gas turbines and 2 steam turbines with a contracted power capacity of 445 megawatts, as well as contracted water production capacity of 15 million imperial gallons per day. It also supplies power and water to the Oman Power and Water Procurement Company. Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Salalah, Oman.
